about: Demo emails: completed work orders from Northwind Repair's dispatcher. Two emails share WO-1042 (a follow-up visit), so the workflow must total per work-order number. Send the first five before the demo; send the 'live' one during it to show a rerun picking up only the new order. Expected invoices: WO-1042 Acme $419.20, WO-1043 Brightside $344.50, WO-1044 Harbor View $423.49, WO-1045 Acme $691.20; live WO-1046 Brightside $264.00.
